style.backgroundSystem: unglazed terracotta-tile platform against layered #F5EFE4 linen folds, shallow depth, nothing else in the distance
style.direction: warm brick-red feminine care still-life commerce
style.iconSystem: thin-line grey-violet #8B7E96 open-arc icons, 2px stroke, rounded caps, unfilled, quiet and sparse
style.lightingSystem: single warm 4900K key from the upper left at 45 degrees, soft-edged but directional, long soft cast shadow toward the lower right, gentle bounce fill, no hard specular hotspots
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: warm tactile feminine-care still life across the whole set; fixed palette of off-white linen #F5EFE4, warm brick red #A8442F, grey violet #8B7E96 and clay-ink text #3C322E; warm grade; unglazed terracotta tile platform over layered linen folds; single warm 4900K key from the upper left producing long soft shadows; one rounded humanist sans-serif; thin-line grey-violet open-arc icons; honest fiber and paper texture with real contact shadows; stable centering and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no random backgrounds or props outside terracotta tile and linen
no inconsistent lighting direction or color temperature
no brand name, logo, watermark, QR code, membership badge or store badge
no price, discount, coupon, shipping or count claims
no size, length, weight, absorbency or material-composition figures
no antibacterial, medical, clinical, hospital or lab endorsement wording
no registration, filing, standard or certification numbers
no menstrual fluid, blood, stain or any body-in-use depiction
no faces, no full figures, no visible underwear in use
style.presentationRules: product centered and level, stable 3/4 and overhead angles, real contact shadow under every piece, never floating, full pad silhouette kept inside the frame, no tilt of vertical edges
style.surfaceSystem: matte unglazed terracotta tile with fine grain, raw linen weave with soft folds, honest fiber and paper texture
style.typography: one rounded humanist sans-serif family for all copy, headline 28-40pt in #3C322E, subtitle 16-20pt, labels 12-14pt in #8B7E96, generous tracking, no mixing of other faces
